name: Gram Gold
oneLiner: Token Teknoloji's gram-gold stablecoin has conflicting issuer disclosures about whether PAXG or physical gold backs current supply.
collateral: Token Teknoloji's public materials conflict: product copy says equivalent PAXG is held on-chain, while the same page's FAQ and the issuer's reserve disclosures say physical gold is held at Turkish banks, the Central Bank, and company vaults. No current primary evidence reconciles the reserve form or proportions.
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed mint/redeem and exchange conversion route for a one-gram gold claim; public materials support reserve backing but do not expose a reviewed direct holder redemption schedule suitable for a Pharos backstop config

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: GRAMG uses Token Teknoloji issuer-native StableCoin contracts on Avalanche and Polygon. Direct source verification resolves externalTransfer/externalTransferFrom burn/mint functions controlled by the issuer supply manager, so the previous Across/Avalanche route signal is not the durable supply path.

mintAuthority.summary: GRAMG uses direct, immutable StableCoin deployments on Avalanche and Polygon. On Avalanche, EOA 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb is both owner and supply manager. On Polygon, EOA 0xd61c0129f6c35a675db6e2a067b31e75b2573077 is both owner and supply manager, while the Avalanche EOA is the live proposed owner and can claim ownership immediately. Each current owner or supply manager can mint without an on-chain supply cap.

controls.label: GRAMG Avalanche supply-manager and owner EOA
controls.capDescription: StableCoin.mint(uint256) has no aggregate supply ceiling and permits either supplyManager() or owner() to mint.
controls.evidence: At Avalanche block 90233120, owner() and supplyManager() both returned 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb, proposedOwner() was zero, and eth_getCode on the authority returned 0x. Verified StableCoin source permits the owner or supply manager to call uncapped mint(uint256).

controls.label: GRAMG Polygon supply-manager and owner EOA
controls.capDescription: StableCoin.mint(uint256) has no aggregate supply ceiling and permits either supplyManager() or owner() to mint.
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 90179923, owner() and supplyManager() both returned 0xd61c0129f6c35a675db6e2a067b31e75b2573077 and eth_getCode returned 0x. The runtime hash matched Avalanche exactly for this asset, and verified StableCoin source permits the owner or supply manager to call uncapped mint(uint256).

controls.label: GRAMG Polygon pending-owner EOA
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 90179923, proposedOwner() returned 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb. Verified Claimable ownership lets this EOA call claimOwnership without another current-owner action, after which owner() can mint or replace the supply manager immediately. eth_getCode returned 0x.

review.evidence: At Avalanche block 90233120 and Polygon block 90179923, both GRAMG deployments were direct contracts with zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots. Their runtime hashes matched at 0xffab59d79ea7dc35c20554c87d8fbc7e0b0ec34a81001f9f412dc5ba18d8b8f8. Avalanche owner and supply manager were EOA 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb. Polygon owner and supply manager were EOA 0xd61c0129f6c35a675db6e2a067b31e75b2573077, with the Avalanche EOA staged as proposed owner. Verified source permits each current owner or supply manager to mint uncapped supply and permits the proposed owner to claim Polygon ownership without delay.
